JVNDB-2026-000106
Cybozu Garoon vulnerable to cross-site scripting
Overview
Scheduler in Cybozu Garoon provided by Cybozu, Inc contains the following vulnerability:
Cross-Site Scripting (CWE-79) - CVE-2026-57279
CyCDB-4148
Cybozu, Inc reported this vulnerability to JPCERT/CC to notify users of its solution through JVN. JPCERT/CC and Cybozu, Inc coordinated under the Information Security Early Warning Partnership.

Affected Products
Cybozu, Inc.
Cybozu Garoon versions from 6.17.0 to 6.17.1
Impact
An arbitrary script may be executed in the web browser of a user logged in to the product.
Solution
[Update the Software]
Update the software to the latest version according to the information provided by the developer.
